name: XP
request: Help me set up for fast XP on this character. Check what I have installed and what my account owns, and get me to a working setup.
hints: XP goal. Call get_location for the current character and map, get_account_access for Owned Content, and list_installed_modules plus get_module_settings for what the Player already has. Prefer Installed Modules, proposing enable_module through Review for one that is installed but disabled; when nothing installed covers the goal, propose installing it from the Catalog when an install Action is available, otherwise tell the Player how to install it by hand. At max level XP feeds mastery tracks, so get_progress with kind mastery applies too. Use list_marker_packs and find_marker_categories for packs with leveling or event categories; propose download_pack when one is needed and give the category display path as directions. If Pathing is installed but disabled, propose enable_module through Review and continue configuring it after it applies. If Pathing is missing, propose installing it from the Catalog when an install Action is available; otherwise tell the Player how to install it by hand. Never claim to have turned a category on.
